title: lobularia canariensis subsp. fruticosa
intro: Lobularia canariensis subsp. fruticosa, commonly known as Sweet Alyssum, is a flowering plant species native to the Canary Islands. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Alyssum include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These compounds work together to provide a calming and soothing effect on the body, making Sweet Alyssum a popular choice for natural remedies and aromatherapy products.
